information_gain: the public Z0 route fails the frozen Batch039 quality contract
four nominal last-layer parameters are exactly inactive under the Z0 measurement interface
parity readout reduces that exact inactive tail from four parameters to two
the parity route clears the accuracy gate but not the BCE gate before calibration
a two-scalar classical calibration layer clears both frozen quality thresholds in ideal simulation
meeting quality does not establish any speed, energy, provider-cost or end-to-end economic advantage
